$schema_note: Anchor records for the marketplace trust layer. Each record: a Nostr event (kind 8555, signed by the marketplace-anchor pubkey below) carrying sha256 digests of the live agent surfaces at fetch time, published to public relays, its canonical serialization stored as <event_id>.evt (sha256(.evt) == event_id per NIP-01) and stamped into Bitcoin via OpenTimestamps (<event_id>.evt.ots). how_to_check: (1) sha256 the .evt file and confirm it equals the event id; (2) verify the event signature against anchor_pubkey (NIP-01 schnorr); (3) ots verify -d <event_id> <event_id>.evt.ots against any Bitcoin explorer; (4) fetch the event by id from the listed relays for the third-party copy. The repo history of this folder is itself an additional weak anchor.
